demo.cliff: which fields the ledger writes and which the referee does
teaches: relation and status carry a closed list because chargen writes them from code — Allie, Contact, Rival, Enemy, Patron, and Alive, Unknow, Dead.
attitude deliberately carries no list: it is the referee's word for how this person is taking things today.
skill.speciality and skill.characteristic are what the contact is good for, so a check can be offered against them.
provenance records where the contact came from: which term, which career, which table.
demo.trap: system.actor is left empty on purpose. It is a cross-Actor UUID, and a single drag out of a compendium does not keep document ids — the reference would arrive broken in the referee's world. The written details below are what survive; link the Actor by hand once both are in the world.

system.description: Keeps the harbour ledger, and remembers every hull that ever came in light.
system.attitude: Owes a favour, and would rather not be reminded
system.title: Clerk of the Harbour
system.notes: Signed off a manifest they should not have, once, and has been careful ever since. Will trade a berth for a name.

provenance.note: Event roll of 9: a quiet word from the Harbourmaster.
